references.text: Concerns the holy gifts belonging to the priest, including what the people bring as offerings
Describes the holy offerings that the Israelites are to bring to the Lord
Earlier in the chapter, the same requirement is mentioned to bring offerings to the place the Lord chooses
Parallel text about bringing burnt offerings, peace offerings, tithes, and vows to the place the Lord chooses
Prohibition against eating holy gifts at one's own home; they must be brought to the chosen place
Laws concerning vows to the Lord that must be kept and fulfilled
Rules for vow offerings and voluntary offerings brought to the Lord
Laws about holy vows and how they are to be fulfilled before the Lord
